# Actions

Composer, Message, Conversation, and Navigation use domain-specific action types with shared id, label, icon, order, visible, enabled, badge, intent, and accessibilityLabel semantics.

## Principle

The kit provides sensible defaults; capabilities own business availability; host configuration owns trimming and order; targeted extension points replace only what truly differs.

## Contract

A host list is a full replacement: omission uses defaults, an empty list removes all, and an explicit list owns trimming, order, and extension. Disabled actions remain; hidden actions are removed.

## Platforms

Vue, Flutter, Compose, and SwiftUI align semantically while retaining native syntax and interaction.

## Validation

Configuration tests cover defaults, removal, hiding, disabling, reordering, custom entries, and capability filtering.
